google.name: Google Interviewer
questions: Tell me about a time you solved a complex technical problem at scale.
How would you design a URL shortener system like Bitly?
Given an array of integers, find the longest subarray with sum equal to zero.
How do you handle ambiguity in requirements during a project?
Explain a time you had to make a trade-off between speed and quality.

amazon.name: Amazon Interviewer
questions: Tell me about a time you disagreed with your manager. How did you handle it?
Describe a situation where you took ownership of a project and delivered results.
How do you prioritize when you have multiple competing deadlines?
Tell me about a time you failed and what you learned from it.
How do you ensure customer satisfaction in a product you own?

meta.name: Meta Interviewer
questions: How would you measure the success of a new Facebook feature?
Design the news feed algorithm for a social media platform.
Given a list of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals.
How would you approach building a feature that increases user engagement by 10%?
Tell me about a time you had to make a decision with incomplete data.

microsoft.name: Microsoft Interviewer
questions: How do you foster collaboration in a cross-functional team?
Describe a time you had to learn a new technology quickly to solve a problem.
How would you design a caching layer for a high-traffic web application?
Tell me about a time you received negative feedback and how you responded.
How do you balance innovation with stability in a product?
